goal: Allow external applications using libbitcoinkernel to inspect script execution state step-by-step
Enable building script debuggers, execution analyzers, and better interpreter testing tools
agreement: Broad concept support for enabling script debugging and better testing tools
Verified by building a visualizer and testing Python bindings with no issues found (elmeriniemela)
Earlier review suggestions addressed, pending re-review (alexanderwiederin)
Unanswered objection on reporting control-flow opcodes in inactive branches as skipped (w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it adds an optional build-time tracing tool rather than core library functionality
External developers can build script debuggers, but standard library consumers are unaffected
